name: celestea-studio-ts
description: Celestea Studio backend - TypeScript rewrite (P0: contract freeze + skeleton + golden-sample toolchain)

scripts.lint:arch: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages apps/studio apps/cli scripts tests
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:arch && pnpm test && pnpm check:web
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir apps/web run build && CELESTEA_BUNDLE_STRICT=1 pnpm --dir apps/web run check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run release:check
